query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS acquisition_readiness_alerts (
  id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,
  venture_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  venture_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  alert_type VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  severity VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Medium',
  title VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL,
  description TEXT,
  trigger_value DECIMAL(10,2),
  threshold_value DECIMAL(10,2),
  recommended_action TEXT,
  status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Active',
  acknowledged_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  resolved_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS acquisition_readiness_scores (
  id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,
  venture_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  overall_score INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  financial_attractiveness INT DEFAULT 0,
  ip_value INT DEFAULT 0,
  market_position INT DEFAULT 0,
  team_quality INT DEFAULT 0,
  mission_protection_strength INT DEFAULT 0,
  governance_maturity INT DEFAULT 0,
  acquisition_risk_level VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'Low',
  notes TEXT,
  recorded_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
